description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1807/17 of 24.04.2013, Ratmalana D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 521001 and other Amendments
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically expunging particulars of specific land parcels in various locations. The content focuses on land administration matters including cadastral maps, land parcel numbers, block numbers, and village locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
